preset.text: Two armies of ten: 3 rock, 4 paper, 3 scissors. Blue starts in the bottom-left corner, Red in the top-right.
On your turn you move one piece one square — straight or diagonally, in any of the eight directions. That is the whole move. You must move; there is no passing.
Step onto an enemy you beat and you capture it. Rock takes scissors, scissors takes paper, paper takes rock.
You cannot step onto your own piece — or onto an enemy that beats you. A rock simply cannot enter a square held by paper, so pieces genuinely wall each other off.
Get any one of your pieces into your opponent's corner — Blue is aiming at I9, Red at A1. First one there wins. If you ever have no legal move at all, you lose.
